pattern.description: The camera pushes in on the critical web-store node while its ring turns from red to a purple-pink gradient. Thick gradient edges then draw outward along its dependencies, and the caption wipes off to clear the view.
pattern.why_premium: Brand-gradient colour marks the one service that matters among dozens of grey nodes. Drawing the edges outward shows its blast radius without any extra copy.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to(map, {scale: 1.16, x: -20, y: -30, transformOrigin: '35% 30%', duration: 0.5, ease: 'power2.inOut'}).to(ringGradient, {opacity: 1, duration: 0.2, ease: 'power1.out'}, '-=0.2').fromTo('.edge', {strokeDashoffset: (i, el) => el.getTotalLength()}, {strokeDashoffset: 0, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.out', stagger: 0.04}, '<').to(caption, {clipPath: 'inset(0 0 0 100%)', duration: 0.2, ease: 'power2.in'}, '<').
build_hint.remotion: Map scale 1 to 1.16 with interpolate + Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic). Crossfade the gradient ring opacity over 6 frames. Draw each edge's strokeDashoffset to 0 with spring({damping: 200, stiffness: 180}) (no overshoot), each delayed 1 frame more than the last. Caption clip-path inset left goes 0 to 100% via interpolate.

notes: The caption is not on the end frame, so its manual box marks where it sat before the wipe. The edge box is a rough envelope around several separate lines. Code verdict is camera push_in (scale 1.16).
